items.name: Uiverse Galaxy

license.scope: MIT for the repository's elements; attribution to the creator and Uiverse.io is requested but not required.

items.summary: The open-source repository behind Uiverse: thousands of community-made HTML/CSS and Tailwind elements (buttons, cards, toggles, loaders, inputs, tooltips) in per-element files.
items.useWhen: Use when a page needs one specific micro-interaction (an animated button, toggle, loader or card) instead of writing the CSS animation by hand; copy only the selected element.
cautions: Quality, accessibility and browser support vary per element; add focus states, reduced-motion handling and semantic markup before shipping.
Copy single elements, not the collection, and map hard-coded colors to the project's tokens.

sources.title: Galaxy repository, element folders and MIT license

install: Browse the element on uiverse.io or in the Galaxy folder, copy its HTML/CSS (or Tailwind) into the project, and record the source path.
Replace hard-coded colors with project tokens and test keyboard, focus and prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: Awesome UI Components (brandonhimpfen)

license.scope: The list text is CC BY-SA 4.0 per its README license link (the badge's alt text says CC0). Each linked project keeps its own license.

items.summary: Actively maintained curated list of UI component libraries, design systems, headless kits, accessibility-focused components, animation libraries and icon sets.
items.useWhen: Use to discover candidates when no Genlib record fits a UI need, instead of open-ended web searching; then evaluate the chosen library's license and maintenance directly.
cautions: Listing is not endorsement or a license review; verify each project's license, maintenance and accessibility yourself.
Reusing the list's own text requires CC BY-SA attribution and share-alike.
install: Read the relevant section, shortlist at most three libraries, and add the selected one as a Genlib resource record with its own license and links.

items.name: Awesome UI Resources (al-husayn)

license.scope: MIT for the list repository. Each linked registry, generator or framework keeps its own license and terms.

items.summary: Hub of UI resources for developers: shadcn-compatible component registries, color palette generators, Tailwind frameworks and design tools.
items.useWhen: Use to find a shadcn-compatible registry, palette generator or Tailwind add-on instead of searching the web; then review the chosen source before copying.
cautions: Registries copied into a project become project code; check each registry's license and accessibility before adoption.
Listing is not endorsement; confirm maintenance and terms for each linked tool.
install: Read the relevant section, shortlist candidates, and record the selected source as a Genlib resource with its own license and links.
